method: One-way screening: nominal rectangular straight RVT duct side surfaces to nearest CAD triangle surface (including sloped transitions). 100 mm maximum longitudinal sampling pitch; 4 points across each side; 50 mm end trim. XYZ residual = CAD nearest surface point minus RVT sample. No fitting, translation, rotation, or Z compensation. This is not a bijective object match or full BRep equivalence proof. Candidate CAD includes generic-layer solids; unknown semantics require review. Fittings, insulation, round ducts, end faces and other ducts excluded.
